SELECT ae.aggregator_id, ae.ent_id, ae.ent_name AS entName, ae.longitude, ae.latitude, IFNULL(SUM(aed.power), 0.0) AS totalPower FROM aggregator_ent ae
INNER JOIN aggregator_ent_device aed ON ae.aggregator_id = aed.aggregator_id AND ae.ent_id = aed.ent_id AND aed.resource_type_id = #{resourceTypeId} AND aed.model_flag = 1
LEFT JOIN aggregator_ent_device aed ON ae.aggregator_id = aed.aggregator_id AND ae.ent_id = aed.ent_id
WHERE ae.aggregator_id = #{aggregatorId} GROUP BY ae.aggregator_id, ae.ent_id, ae.ent_name, ae.longitude, ae.latitude;
select distinct(`percent`) from aggregator_ent where aggregator_id = #{aggregatorId} order by `percent`
SELECT * FROM aggregator_ent e WHERE e.status = 1 AND e.station_id IN( SELECT station_id FROM aggregator_ent_device d WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.resource_type_id = #{resourTypeId} )
SELECT * FROM aggregator_ent_device d WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.resource_type_id = #{resourTypeId}
